label: Batch: folder → rendering (Flux2 Klein edit)
description: A folder of pictures (photos or clay renders, subfolders included) rendered one after the other by Flux2 Klein image edit, one prompt and one seed for a consistent series. The results go to a new folder next to it, <name>_renders, with the same subfolders and each file's name plus the Save node's Batch Suffix.

nodes.name: Prompt
nodes.label: Prompt
nodes.text: Re-render this picture as a finished photorealistic photograph, keeping exactly the same shapes, proportions, openings and the same camera view. Describe the materials here: for example a perforated copper skin, deep windows with dark glass, a glazed ground floor, a light concrete plinth. Soft even daylight, sharp architectural photograph.

params.s: Change the camera angle to a first-person driver's perspective looking through the steering wheel at the dashboard and windshield, maintaining the same minimalist style and lighting

nodes.name: Frame
nodes.label: How to use
nodes.text:
1. Media Folder: choose a folder of pictures
   (photos or clay renders; subfolders too)
2. Describe the materials in Prompt
3. Run Graph: one picture after the other,
   progress and time left on the folder node
4. Results: a new folder <name>_renders next
   to yours, same subfolders, name + suffix
   (Save › Batch Suffix). Stop, then Run Graph
   again: it goes on with what is missing
